name: Reverb
help:
# reverb

Visual reverb/echo effect

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------|-------------|
| iterations | int | 3 | 1-8 | Iterations |
| ridges | boolean | false | - | Ridges |
| alpha | float | 1.0 | 0-1 | Blend amount |
| wrap | int | mirror | mirror/repeat/clamp | Wrap |
